jobs.label: Tenue d’assaut
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated torso armor ITEM ICON for Project RL, a grimdark futuristic roguelike. The reference is an existing complete OUTFIT, provided only to identify the chest garment, its finish and materials. Redraw ONLY its upper-body garment or chest armor as a freestanding inventory object, from neck opening to waist/hips, with shoulder pieces and short upper sleeves if present. A clearly EMPTY wearable object, not a living torso: transparent empty collar and sleeve openings, no human inside, no mannequin, no skin, no head, no helmet, no mask, no hood, no hands, no forearms, no legs, no boots, no weapon. For robes and long coats make a compact upper-garment item silhouette, no long skirt or full-body silhouette. Keep the reference chest design recognizable, original material colors and identity; do not invent ornaments or text. Slightly elevated frontal game item view, near symmetric readable large masses, similar proportions to a breastplate icon; no dramatic perspective. Match the accepted matte worn painted game finish: controlled dark contours, broad shadow planes, locally scuffed metal or worn cloth, restrained highlights. Not shiny plastic, not noisy microdetail, not vector clipart. The object will fill about 52 of a 64 pixel inventory cell; prioritize a strong torso silhouette and few large readable divisions. Exactly ONE COMPLETE object with a finished lower hem, no crop, generous clear margins at every edge, true transparent background, no cast shadow, no floor, no frame, no label. A sleeveless dirty beige fabric protective tank top / vest, olive drab waist harness and dark low belt, thick slightly ragged cloth, no sleeves. This is an empty fabric ITEM, not a muscular torso, not flesh, no arms or skin. Keep the compact simple chest garment of the reference.
